notes.title: Changelist version 0.1.0.3368
notes.content:
Firstly we just wanted to thank the community for all of the helpful feedback on Discord and the Steam Forums as well as the streaming and Youtube community providing us with a first hand account of all the things we can do to improve the game. We've been paying attention, and the performance message has been heard loud and clear. We've been working over the last few days to try and identify some of the ways we can improve this, and this patch represents a big leap forward. We've found and eliminated one of the biggest contributors to FPS loss at night. You should see an improvement all across the map. Internal testing now shows FPS is consistent day and night. There are still FPS issues when travelling into asset rich areas. They are caused by loading times and we will be looking at ways to improve those as well. We've also addressed all reported quest issues as we try to make the missions robust no matter what order you complete them in. Keep the feedback coming, it really is appreciated.

-made the hand held torches stop casting shadows (BIG fps win at night)
-game saves full screen and resolution correctly, also now defaults to full screen (FPS improvement for some video cards)
-fix for typo in Nightmarcher tutorial
-created a black full-screen widget that hides the brief space between end slides
-Removed duplicate collectible
-fix for seeing 2 Kia's in ending
-replacement set desc for the duplicated collectible
-removing duplicate note
-updated Kihei dialog
-Fixed mission What Happened to Poki?
-Added an autosave to when you get your Kidnapped Kid mission increment (could previously be lost at death)
-Fixing up Sal's room / Cap interaction spot
-Fixed the slamma vendor machine
-Added 'breadcrumb' mission to Capture 2 OPs for TRI when Q'Son tells you to 'come back' (Main Lab)
-Fixed bug w/ Leroy offerring Dog Man mission again and adjusted his attractor so the camera isn't inside a mesh while dialoging
-Fixed bug w/ Zarine disappearing from Delta Site if player visited TRI Main Lab beforehand
-Adding dialog for ghost and mutant Honu
-stop music on begin end slides
-Fix for double bot spawns
-Fixed issue with "With Our Powers Combined" disappearing automatically (still may need to be looked at) and more Kirkland dialog fixes, 
-Fixed issue w/ Ailiana's "Last Steps" dialog falling out/stalling, 
-Fixed issue w/ "Last Steps" not completing and disappearing correctly 
-fixing floaty road bug
-Fixed bug with sometimes losing weapons from inventory when looting a similar type
-Added breadcrumb mission to "Visit Kirkland at the New Islander Settlement" when you complete "Intervention" by moving them next to Manoa Falls
-Fixed bug w/ "Find Q'Son at TRI Main Lab" mission pushing again on revisit to Delta Site

Known Issues. This patch has a small problem with the credit screen losing focus, making it difficult to close. Simply clicking on the esc button with the mouse should exit you out. It will be addressed in our next patch, but given the performance and quest improvements in this patch, it didn't seem important enough to delay. We will fix it ASAP. 

-Fixed mission What Happened to Poki? This quest is now working as intended, but for anyone who has already attempted this quest and run into trouble I will be posting a solution below to allow you to move forward.
- The Wyrmbyte Team.

notes.title: Developer Diary #4: The Factions of Oahu - Lava Dogs, Hawaiians, and Raiders
notes.content:
In last week’s blog, we dove a little deeper into The Research Institute (T.R.I.) and the Islanders. In this week’s blog, we will take a look at the remaining factions that Kai will meet on his adventure throughout Ashes of Oahu. Kai will be able to interact with the Lava Dogs and Hawaiians and gain or lose reputation depending on his choices. The final faction, the Raiders, will always be his enemy.

[h1]The Lava Dogs[/h1]


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815199/83b3a20568d7f8f9490a41c8c7a7c32920b5b286.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815199/83b3a20568d7f8f9490a41c8c7a7c32920b5b286.jpg[/img][/url]


Before the Hekili Nui Marine Corps Base Hawaii dominated the peninsula that makes up the western coastline of Kanoe Bay. This is the original home of the Lava Dogs. The majority of the base was destroyed, and most of the Marines were killed. Fortunately, a number of the Marines survived because they were in air transport after a field exercise and avoided most of the damage. Shortly after the Event, this military force established themselves as a sort of peacekeeping force for the average Islander, not because they wanted to but because they felt it was their duty to. They had sworn an oath to defend these people against all enemies, foreign and domestic. They have since acted as arbiters of disputes, and helpers in the face of calamity. The Lava Dogs are skilled in the use of automatic weapons, and explosives and will be able to help Kai increase his proficiency with these items. Two of the earliest skills Kai will learn are Sidearms and Craft Bullets. Sidearms will increase Kai’s damage with pistols while Craft Bullets will allow Kai to craft bullets in the field. A later skill Kai will have the opportunity to learn is Automatic Weapons. This will increase Kai’s overall damage with automatic weapons.

[h1]Hawaiians[/h1]


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815199/b57e478483e78c5197fac93f36e2bc458b21b4f4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815199/b57e478483e78c5197fac93f36e2bc458b21b4f4.jpg[/img][/url]


Some Islanders witnessed the Hekili Nui and believed it to be direct intervention by the akua. These Islanders peacefully united behind a family of Kanaka Maoli who claim to trace their bloodlines back to Hawaiian royalty of pre-colonial times. These Kanaka see themselves as the true inheritors of Oahu and believe that they are endowed by the akua with the responsibility to lead and govern the entire island.

The Hawaiians are few in number, and to many, they are merely rumors and stories of the old ways. In reality, they are a fundamentalist culture that views themselves as oppressed and fighting for their very survival. The other factions are keenly aware that the Hawaiians really exist and some actively prey on them. Because of their attunement with nature, the Hawaiians can improve both the body and spirit. If Kai chooses to assist them in maintaining their way of life, he can gain access to skills early on such as Sprinting, and Health. Sprinting will increase Kai’s run speed and prolong his stamina. Health improves Kai’s health pool. With continued support, Kai will gain access to Kapu Kuialua, which will increase his damage with melee weapons.

[h1]Raiders[/h1]


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815199/640f3bfcd0dd2c80d710f9f1f442e8a7e48f1e71.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815199/640f3bfcd0dd2c80d710f9f1f442e8a7e48f1e71.jpg[/img][/url]


The raiders are the antithesis of all that is good about the island of Oahu. They are the vicious army of the Mad Kupua. Soulless husks with bodies covered in scarification, mutilation, and scrap metal armor. They fight relentlessly until the enemies of the Mad Kupua have all been destroyed or enslaved. They are the embodiment of evil incarnate.

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/AshesOfOahuGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/AshesofOahu/]Facebook[/url] for all the latest news and updates! Want to chat with the devs? Join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/KhW7uSj]Discord[/url]!
